text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Oh my gosh, oh my gosh! Did you guyssee yesterday's Running Love episode?That last scene was so good!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"I love you from the top of your ears to<n>the tip of
your tail..." My heart! When's<n>someone gonna say
that to me?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Heh. You know, if someone actually said<n>that to
me, I think I'd get a bit flustered.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Love... how marvelous! ☆ Love is<n>absolutely
MARVELOUS! ★☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Sooo, what kinda person would you two<n>want to
be swept off your feet by?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
As for me, I'd want it to be someone<n>who'd love
me forever and ever!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I'd want them to be<n>MAAARVELOUS! ☆★
Someone<n>super-duper marvelous who I could<n>
spread marvels with! ☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, those both sound wonderful!<n>Anyone would
be lucky to be together<n>with either of you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Personally... I guess I'd like someone<n>willing to
love the things I love, like my<n>father's special
omelet recipe, or cherry<n>blossom season.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Well Laurel, whoever gets to be withyou is in for a heart-throbbing time.They'd be the luckiest person in theworld!
